name: Sika® Air - LS
summary: Sika® Air-LS is an air-entraining agent based on synthetic surfactants. It is a diluted version of Sika® Air and therefore performs and fulfils the same function as Sika® Air but at higher dose rates, to enable more accurate dosing. Its efficiency is based upon the entrainment into the mix of a high number of correctly sized and evenly distributed air bubbles.
metaDescription: Sika® Air-LS is an air-entraining agent based on synthetic surfactants. It is a diluted version of Sika® Air and therefore performs and fulfils the same function as Sika® Air but at higher dose rates, to enable more accurate dosing. attributes: Increases cohesion and reduces the risk of segregation;
usage: Sika® Air LS is used to:
Improve resistance to freeze-thaw cycles in hardened concrete;
Increase cohesion, reducing the concrete tendency to bleed and segregate;
Improve compaction of low workability mixes including semi-dry concrete.
advantages: Increases cohesion and reduces the risk of segregation;

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text: Sika® Air-LS meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard AS 1478.1-2000 for Air-entraining admixture (AEA).

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: In unopened original container 12 months at least

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store at temperature between 5ºC and 35º C protected from direct sunlight and frost

items.label: Specific advice
items.text: Exact dosage rates of Sika® Air-LS can be determined by air meter tests in trial mixes.

items.label: Dispensing
items.text: Sika ® Air-LS is added directly to the mixing water

items.label: Compatibility
items.text: Sika® Air - LS is compatible with all the water reducer (WR), mid range water reducer (MWR), high range water reducer (HWR), set accelerator and set retarder manufactered by Sika Australia PTY LTD.

items.label: Recommended dosage
items.text: Typical dosage rates for general concrete production range from 250-750 mls per cubic metre of concrete. For low slump concrete (<65 mm slump) and pavement type concrete, particularly concrete that contains high volume of fly ash, substantially higher dose rate of Sika Air LS may be required to achieve the desired air content. Typical dose rates for high volume fly ash or low slump concrete range from 500-3000 ml per cubic metre of concrete.
